name: restate_rule
description: Record, in your own words, exactly what the rule requires and does not require.

rule_summary.description: A one-sentence restatement of the rule.

name: examine_cards
description: Acknowledge that you have examined the visible fact about all four people.

reviewed.description: Set to true once you have read all four visible facts.

name: note_disproof
description: Record the single hidden fact that, if revealed, would prove the rule is being broken.

falsifying_observation.description: What hidden fact, about which visible person, would break the rule.

name: select_cards
description: Record the single combination of people you will check to test the rule.

selection.description: The combination of people to check.
